newsitem.title: LATVIA: 1996 GDP ROSE 2.8 PCT TO 2.8 BILLION LATS.
newsitem.headline: 1996 GDP ROSE 2.8 PCT TO 2.8 BILLION LATS.

text.p: Latvian gross domestic product (GDP) in real prices rose by 2.8 percent in 1996 to 2.8 billion lats from 2.3 billion lats in 1995, the statistics committee said on Thursday.
The committee said the figures were provisional and may change as more data comes in from company results.
It also said that the base year has been adjusted to 1995 prices from 1993 prices.
The increase in 1996 GDP was due mainly to successful work in the services sector, where the added value during 1996 increased by 4.7 percent from the previous year.
The main rises were in transport and communications, up 13.5 percent, in industry, up 3.1 percent and construction, which showed a rise of 5.3 percent, the office said in a statement.
